register.labelZh: SPILL 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: spill out 可以描述文件、硬幣、衣物等從袋、盒或行李箱掉出並散落四周。；spill out 可以表示某人突然說出大量說話、感受或細節,甚至無法控制自己。；spill over 可以描述問題、興奮、壓力或其他影響蔓延至原本範圍以外。；spill over 可以描述水、牛奶、湯等液體漫過容器邊緣。
register.summaryEn: Spill out helps you describe papers, coins, clothes and other things falling from bags, boxes or cases and spreading around. Spill out can show that somebody suddenly says many words, feelings or details without being able to control them. Spill over can describe trouble, excitement, stress or other effects moving beyond their original place or situation. Spill over helps you describe water, milk, soup and other liquids flowing over the edge of a container.
